title: vtc-00: forbidden on join leaks invisible calls
description: Non-members get notFound for chat-bound calls (draft-atwood-jmap-vtc-00.md:1584), but joining returns forbidden for missing view permission or Chat membership (:867), confirming the call exists. Same pattern as jmap-chat-spec-jlsm.4.
close_reason: Join returns notFound for missing view permission, non-membership of bound Chat, or initiator block.
